full_judgment: III. The SRO No. 365-L/86 published in Bangladesh Gazette dated 23-9-1986 itself shows that the authority published the list of the building of which notice for delivery of possession or taking possession have been served, the contention that notice had not been served in respect of the property in question is not a valid contention or the same cannot be used as rebuttable presumption about the existences of the original owners and, as such, the High Court Division erred in law in directing the authority to release the property.
